definitions.ask: Should copy-bearing mixed Pull-In cards keep 17bd529's no-synthesized-caption rule?
definitions.why: The approved mac_relation_landing_repairs plan required it; Bob's copy feeds every client

choices.label: Update the stale test to expect no context line; Bob's group copy stays the only copy
Drop the copy gate for mixed cards so they show "Unblocked by …" again (product change)

definitions.ask: Should all hand-written fake-bob capture-parse bodies move from grammar 3 to 5, not just failing ones?
definitions.why: Keeps this repair to proven failures so each 15-minute CI round trip has a known outcome

choices.label: Bump only what the failing tests use; file one task bead for the remaining grammar drift
Bump every inline grammar-3 parse body as 9a1876d did; may surface more CI failures

definitions.ask: Should Command-Z after Ctrl-G U also put the caret back where it was?
definitions.why: docs/keyboard.md promises only that undo restores the line, like any native edit

choices.label: No product change; the test stops asserting AppKit's post-undo caret position
Register the original selection in the undo group and document it in docs/keyboard.md
